annotations.title: Pull structured data from a page

description: Read a web page and return the named fields as JSON, using only what the page states; a value the page does not give comes back empty rather than guessed. Name fields, or pass a JSON Schema, or neither for a title, summary and key points. Needs an API key (5 calls from its balance); a failed extraction is refunded.

fields.description: Field names to fill, e.g. ['price', 'founded', 'ceo']. Letters, digits and underscores.

schema.description: A JSON Schema with type 'object', instead of fields.

url.description: Full address, starting http:// or https://.

name: extract_page
title: Pull structured data from a page
